name: ctdsg-fw
description: OctoBus package for CTDSG blacklist IP and domain block or unblock APIs.

CTDSG_FW.CTDSG_FW/BlockIP.name: block-ip
CTDSG_FW.CTDSG_FW/BlockIP.description: Add one or more IPs into the CTDSG blacklist.

CTDSG_FW.CTDSG_FW/UnblockIP.name: unblock-ip
CTDSG_FW.CTDSG_FW/UnblockIP.description: Remove one or more IPs from the CTDSG blacklist.

CTDSG_FW.CTDSG_FW/BlockDomain.name: block-domain
CTDSG_FW.CTDSG_FW/BlockDomain.description: Add one or more domains into the CTDSG blacklist.

CTDSG_FW.CTDSG_FW/UnblockDomain.name: unblock-domain
CTDSG_FW.CTDSG_FW/UnblockDomain.description: Remove one or more domains from the CTDSG blacklist.
